ai.literal: Against the strong opposition facing let one avoid; without fail weak ones upon let one desire enmity.
ai.translation: Avoid standing in opposition against those who are stronger than you. But eagerly undertake enmity against those who are weaker.
ai.modern: தம்மினும் வலியவர்களிடம் பகை கொள்வதைத் தவிர்க்க வேண்டும். ஆனால் தம்மினும் மெலியவர்களிடம் தவறாமல் பகை கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet advises a strategic approach to conflict and enmity. It warns against taking on enemies who are stronger, as that leads to certain defeat and ruin. Conversely, it suggests that one should not hesitate to engage in conflict with those who are weaker, as victory is assured. The word 'ஓம்பா' emphasizes acting without hesitation or fail, while 'மேக' encourages actively pursuing such advantageous enmity.

ai.literal: Love he-is-without; strong ally he-is-without; himself he-is-not-strong; how will-he-break enemy's strength?
ai.translation: He has no love in his heart, no strong allies to support him, and no strength of his own. How can such a man break the power of his enemy?
ai.modern: சுற்றத்தாரிடம் அன்பு இல்லாதவனாகவும், வலிமையான துணை இல்லாதவனாகவும், தானும் வலிமை அற்றவனாகவும் இருக்கும் ஒருவன், தன் பகைவனின் வலிமையை எப்படி அழிக்க முடியும்?
ai.explanation: This couplet describes a person who is completely vulnerable to his enemies due to three critical flaws. First, he lacks love ('அன்பு'), meaning he has no loyal inner circle of family or friends. Second, he has no powerful allies ('ஆன்ற துணை') to support him from the outside. Third, he lacks personal strength and capability ('தான் துவ்வான்'). The word 'பரியும்' (will break) questions how such an isolated and weak individual could possibly overcome the 'துப்பு' (strength) of his foes.

ai.literal: He fears, he knows not, fitness he is without, he gives not; entirely he is easy to the enemy.
ai.translation: He who is fearful, ignorant, lacking in adaptability, and ungenerous, is an easy prey to his enemies.
ai.modern: எதற்கும் பயப்படுகிறவனாகவும், அறிய வேண்டியவற்றை அறியாதவனாகவும், பிறரோடு பொருந்தி வாழும் பண்பு இல்லாதவனாகவும், யாருக்கும் எதுவும் கொடுக்காதவனாகவும் இருப்பவன், தன் பகைவருக்கு மிக எளிதில் இரையாவான்.
ai.explanation: This couplet lists four flaws that make a person highly vulnerable to their enemies. The flaws are cowardice ('அஞ்சும்'), ignorance ('அறியான்'), lack of adaptability or good traits ('அமைவு'), and stinginess ('ஈகலான்'). A person with these negative qualities will not have the courage, knowledge, social harmony, or allies needed to defend themselves. Consequently, they become an entirely effortless target ('தஞ்சம் எளியன்') for their foes.

ai.literal: He does not leave anger, he is without self-control; always, everywhere, to anyone, he is easy.
ai.translation: One who never lets go of anger and lacks self-control is an easy target for anyone to defeat, at any time and in any place.
ai.modern: கோபத்தை விடாதவனும், மனக்கட்டுப்பாடு இல்லாதவனும் ஆகிய ஒருவனை எந்த நேரத்திலும், எந்த இடத்திலும், எவரும் எளிதாக வென்றுவிடலாம்.
ai.explanation: This couplet describes the extreme vulnerability of a person who is consumed by anger and lacks self-restraint. The words 'எஞ்ஞான்றும்' (always) and 'யாங்கணும்' (everywhere) emphasize that such a person has no safe haven or moment of security. Because their own internal flaws constantly weaken them, they become an easy target ('எளிது') for any enemy to overcome.

ai.literal: Path he considers not, fitting things he does not, blame he considers not, good character he is without; to foes (he is) sweet.
ai.translation: He who does not consider the right path, does not do what is fitting, ignores disgrace, and lacks good character is a sweet prize for his enemies.
ai.modern: சரியான வழியை ஆராயாமலும், தகுந்த செயல்களைச் செய்யாமலும், பழிக்கு அஞ்சாமலும், நற்பண்பு இல்லாமலும் இருப்பவனை வெல்வது அவனுடைய பகைவர்களுக்கு மிகவும் எளிதானதாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet describes the kind of person who is easily defeated by their enemies. The word 'vaḻi' refers to the proper path or the future consequences of one's actions, which this person fails to consider. They also neglect to do 'vāyppaṉa', the fitting or beneficial deeds that secure their position. Because they ignore the 'paḻi' (blame or disgrace) of their actions and lack 'paṇpu' (good character), they isolate themselves. To their foes, such a flawed and friendless person is 'iṉitu'—a sweet and effortless target to conquer.

ai.literal: Not-seeing he-of-anger, excessive great he-of-desire; enmity to-desire will-be.
ai.translation: The enmity of a man with blind anger and excessive desire is something to be eagerly sought.
ai.modern: எதையும் சீர்தூக்கிப் பார்க்காத கோபமும், அளவுகடந்த ஆசையும் உடையவனின் பகையை நாம் விரும்பி ஏற்கலாம்.
ai.explanation: This couplet identifies the type of enemy whose opposition is actually advantageous. A person blinded by anger cannot think rationally or strategize well. Furthermore, someone consumed by excessive desire is easily manipulated and prone to ruinous mistakes. Because these deep character flaws will naturally lead to their own downfall, one should gladly welcome the enmity of such a person.

ai.literal: Even having given, acquiring is necessary certainly, having approached having been, unexcellent things he who does's enmity.
ai.translation: One must certainly acquire the enmity of a person who stays close but does harmful things, even if one has to pay for it.
ai.modern: தன்னுடனே நெருங்கியிருந்து தீமையான செயல்களைச் செய்பவனின் பகையை, ஒரு பொருளைக் கொடுத்தாவது பெற்றுக்கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet advises on when enmity is actually desirable. If a person remains close as an associate but constantly does harmful or foolish things, their proximity is dangerous. Therefore, the text states that one must certainly acquire their open enmity, even if it requires giving up something valuable to achieve that separation. The word 'மாணாத' refers to actions lacking excellence or virtue, meaning harmful or treacherous deeds.

ai.literal: Virtue being without, faults many if they are, to the enemies ally he becomes without, an advantage it has.
ai.translation: If a ruler lacks virtue and has many faults, he will be left without allies. This condition gives a great advantage to his enemies.
ai.modern: ஒருவன் நற்குணங்கள் இல்லாதவனாகவும், பல குற்றங்கள் உடையவனாகவும் இருந்தால், அவனுக்குத் துணையாக யாரும் இருக்க மாட்டார்கள். இந்த நிலை அவனுடைய பகைவர்களுக்குப் பெரிய நன்மையைத் தரும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains how a ruler's own flaws become his enemy's greatest asset. The word 'குணன்' refers to good qualities, while 'குற்றம்' denotes flaws or misdeeds. When a person lacks virtue and commits many errors, he naturally loses the support of his allies ('இனன் இலனாம்'). This isolation is described as 'ஏமாப்பு உடைத்து' for the enemies, meaning it provides them with a distinct advantage or security, making him an easy target.

ai.literal: To the destroyers, far will not depart joy, wisdom without, fearing enemies if getting.
ai.translation: Joy will never depart far from those who conquer, if they gain enemies who lack wisdom and are full of fear.
ai.modern: அறிவில்லாத, கோழைத்தனமான பகைவர்களைப் பெற்றால், அவர்களை அழிப்பவர்களை விட்டு இன்பம் ஒருபோதும் விலகிச் செல்லாது.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the advantage of having weak and foolish enemies. If a leader faces foes who lack wisdom ('அறிவு இலா') and are easily frightened ('அஞ்சும்'), defeating them becomes effortless. Consequently, the joy of victory and prosperity will never leave the conqueror ('செறுவார்க்கு'). The phrase 'சேண் இகவா' emphasizes that this happiness will remain close and enduring.

ai.literal: Unlearned man's getting angry small matter always him who cannot achieve will not reach glory.
ai.translation: Glory will never reach the man who cannot accomplish the small task of overcoming an ignorant man's anger.
ai.modern: அறிவில்லாதவன் கொள்ளும் சினம் என்னும் சிறிய செயலைக்கூடச் செய்து முடிக்க இயலாதவனை, புகழ் எக்காலத்திலும் சென்றடையாது.
ai.explanation: This couplet highlights how easy it is to defeat an ignorant enemy. The anger of an unlearned man is called a 'small matter' (சிறுபொருள்) because overcoming it requires very little effort and yields an easy advantage. If a leader is unable to accomplish even this simple task, true glory will never reach them. The word 'ஒளி' literally means light, here symbolizing the radiant fame that eludes the incapable.
